MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 48

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 12
   D. 3

5. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

9. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

11. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
